AbsolutePathBuf.description:
A path that is guaranteed to be absolute and normalized (though it is not guaranteed to be canonicalized or exist on the filesystem).

IMPORTANT: When deserializing an `AbsolutePathBuf`, a base path must be set using [AbsolutePathBufGuard::new]. If no base path is set, the deserialization will fail unless the path being deserialized is already absolute.

codexHome.description: Absolute path to the server's $CODEX_HOME directory.

externalInputControlVersion.description: Owner admission and gate controls on the bound receiver: `exclusive_turn` submit, `thread/externalInput/resume` and `thread/externalInput/interrupt`. Absent on older servers.

externalInputDeliveries.description: Supported delivery modes for the private bound receiver. Absent on older servers.

externalInputVersion.description: Private launch-bound common ExternalInput control API version, when enabled.

externalInputVersions.description: Supported submit envelope versions; control status/retry remains v1.

fullTextItemTerminal.description: Every opened public text item receives a full terminal snapshot, including cancellation, upstream failure and early EOF, retained in thread history.

platformFamily.description: Platform family for the running app-server target, for example `"unix"` or `"windows"`.

platformOs.description: Operating system for the running app-server target, for example `"macos"`, `"linux"`, or `"windows"`.

presentationVersion.description: Durable display-only append/status and timeline support on the bound receiver.
